title: Unweighted Shortest-Path BFS
summary: Use a FIFO frontier so vertices are first discovered in nondecreasing number of equal-cost edges from the source.
recognition_signals: the objective is fewest hops or edges
the graph may have multiple routes to the same vertex
core_rules: Mark a vertex discovered when enqueueing it.
The first discovery of a vertex is at minimum hop distance when every edge has equal cost.
structural_steps: enqueue the source at distance zero
enqueue each undiscovered neighbor at distance plus one
stop when the target is discovered or the frontier empties

common_confusions.distinction: BFS is correct when every edge has equal cost. Dijkstra is required when non-negative edge costs differ.
BFS shortest path is a traversal with a specific FIFO invariant that gives a distance guarantee.
